Loyalty

Performance settings in Loyalty configurations

Use the new Performance settings tab to select your loyalty profile and event datasets, and to set your organization's priority Key performance indicator for loyalty insights.

Choose Revenue, Engagement, Redemptions, or Conversions to determine which insights receive emphasis in your feed.

Available October 1, 2026

See official release notes →
Why it helps

Your insights feed highlights the results your program is measured on, so the first thing you see is what matters most to you.

Loyalty

Streak challenge configuration update

The non-consecutive option has been removed when creating Streak challenges.

Streak challenges now use the Task completion requirements drop-down to require either one task or all tasks together to be completed on consecutive days.

Available October 1, 2026

See official release notes →
Why it helps

Set up a streak in one clear choice: members repeat a single task, or complete all tasks together, on every day of the streak.

Loyalty

Autosave for challenge drafts

Challenge edits in Loyalty are now saved automatically as you work, so you can publish a challenge or generate a journey without saving first.

Available October 1, 2026

See official release notes →
Why it helps

Work on a challenge draft without worrying about losing changes, and publish when you are ready.

September 2026

Loyalty · AI

Loyalty Opportunities

The Loyalty Performance menu now includes Opportunities and Trend tabs. They surface AI-detected trends and gaps, such as tier progression friction or challenge task drop-off, each with a projected impact and a one-click Create with AI action that generates a challenge to address it.

You can also ask Coworker for challenge opportunities in the conversational interface, and turn grounded ideas, based on real loyalty program trends, into live challenges without leaving the chat.

Available September 30, 2026

See official release notes →
Why it helps

Spot where members slow down and go from insight to a draft challenge in a single click.

Loyalty

Loyalty challenge details page

Review a challenge's configuration and performance from a dedicated details page: its summary, targeted audience, connected journey, tasks and rewards, alongside key metrics for revenue, enrollment, completion rate and total completions.

Open the full report for more detailed performance insights, or select Edit challenge to modify the challenge.

Available September 30, 2026

See official release notes →
Why it helps

See how a challenge is set up and how it performs in one place, without switching between screens.

Loyalty

Per-member challenge completion deadlines

Under Completion requirements, choose “Within a number of days after opt-in” so each member's deadline is calculated from their own opt-in date rather than a fixed program-wide end date.

If both a challenge end date and this opt-in window are set, each member's deadline is whichever comes first.

Available September 30, 2026

See official release notes →
Why it helps

Give every member the same amount of time to finish, whenever they join.

Loyalty · Content Cards

Challenges domain in the Content Card personalization editor

The Content Card personalization editor now supports Challenges as a domain, so you can access challenge metadata when authoring Content Card personalization.

This makes it easier to create tailored content for each stage of a challenge (Launch, In progress and End) without custom code.

Available September 30, 2026

See official release notes →
Why it helps

Write Content Cards that speak to each stage of a challenge, without asking a developer.

Loyalty · Setup

Loyalty event mapping updates

Creating or editing an Event Mapping now uses a new visual mapping builder: select a schema, pick fields from a searchable field selector, map each field to a loyalty event field with a per-row connection status, and preview the auto-generated JSONata expression, with the option to switch to manual JSONata editing at any time.

In addition, “Event Definitions” in Loyalty admin are now called “Event Mappings”, with a refreshed list view that shows the human-readable Experience event schema name.

Available September 22, 2026

See official release notes →
Why it helps

Connect your event data to loyalty with a guided screen, and check the mapping before you save.

Loyalty
“Forever” Loyalty challenges

Set Challenge end to No end date so an always-on challenge can continue without expiring.

Available September 1, 2026
Why it helps

Keep evergreen engagement programs running without repeatedly recreating or extending the challenge.
